rules.blank_definition: An exactly empty CSV field. Whitespace and literal NA/nan/NULL/X/XNA/C are not silently reclassified.

conditional_rules.condition: FLAG_OWN_CAR equals N and OWN_CAR_AGE is blank
conditional_rules.conflict: A reported car age with FLAG_OWN_CAR=N is preserved and separately flagged, not overwritten.

rules.source: Column families reviewed against the supplied HomeCredit column descriptions and the stored EDA profiles. No target-driven rules.

availability: Stage 1 matched-history coverage. No matched records is not proof of no borrowing or a zero financial value.
sidecars: Original observations are referenced by checksums; sidecar row order and _source_row link to each selected input. Original measurements are not overwritten.
